description: List users, optionally filtered by status and/or a name/email query.

status.description: Optional status filter (e.g. ACTIVE, STAGED, SUSPENDED, DEPROVISIONED).

q.description: Optional case-insensitive query matched against first name, last name, or email.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of serialized user objects.

description: Get a single user by id.

user_id.description: The unique id of the user.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the user object; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new user, optionally activated immediately.

login.description: Optional login; defaults to the email address.

activate.description: Whether to activate the user immediately (default true); otherwise created as STAGED.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created user object.

description: Activate a staged, provisioned, or deprovisioned user.

user_id.description: The unique id of the user to activate.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated user; on failure, output contains an error message.

user_id.description: The unique id of the user to suspend.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated user; on failure, output contains an error message.

user_id.description: The unique id of the user to deactivate.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated user; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: List groups, optionally filtered by a name query.

q.description: Optional case-insensitive query matched against the group name.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of serialized group objects.

description: Get a single group by id.

group_id.description: The unique id of the group.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the group object; on failure (not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the users that are members of a group.

group_id.description: The unique id of the group.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of member user objects; on failure (group not found), output contains an error message.

description: List applications, optionally filtered by status.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of serialized app objects.
